baseline.open_pr_verification: Connected GitHub open-PR search plus individual state readback for all 56 returned pull requests

relationship_facts.rule: Non-ancestor or non-zero delta does not prove unique value. It proves only that wholesale merge or unsupported closure is unsafe until current-main semantic reconciliation.

disposition_rules.EVIDENCE_BEARING_DO_NOT_CLOSE: Preserve the branch and PR until its source, correction and unique-delta value are reconciled; do not merge wholesale.
disposition_rules.PUBLIC_RELEASE_SEPARATE: Requires a fresh current-main release, express publication authority, current evidence/privacy review and exact-head gates; this census grants none of them.
disposition_rules.DELTA_SOURCE_RECONCILE: Technical or continuity proposal only; extract unique still-correct improvements into a fresh bounded transaction after comparison with current controls.
disposition_rules.PRIVATE_OR_UNSAFE_DO_NOT_PORT: Outreach-oriented or potentially private-sensitive work; do not replay to another public host or send externally without a separate source/privacy/authority review.

ambiguity.meaning: Every baseline open PR has one primary handling disposition. This is zero primary-routing ambiguity, not a claim that every unique delta has been adjudicated or that any PR is deletion-safe.
